name: CodeYam Editor
postAttachCommand:
u="https://$CODESPACE_NAME-14199.$GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN"; echo 'Waiting for the CodeYam Editor to start...'; i=0; until curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:14199/; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 300 ]; then echo 'The CodeYam Editor did not start. See .codeyam/logs/codespaces-editor.log'; exit 0; fi; sleep 2; done; printf '
==================================================
  CodeYam Editor is ready. Open it here (Cmd/Ctrl+click):

  %s
==================================================

' "$u"; if [ -n "$BROWSER" ]; then "$BROWSER" "$u" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; true
postCreateCommand: npm install -g @codeyam-editor/codeyam-editor@staging @anthropic-ai/claude-code && npx -y playwright install --with-deps chromium
